en: This is an old, colored postcard. The front shows a panoramic view of a town with a prominent church featuring noticeable tall spires in the center, surrounded by numerous buildings and bordered by wooded hills. There is Swedish text below the image. The back side contains a Swedish postage stamp (5 öre), an address written in Swedish to someone in Uppsala, and the printed word 'BREFKORT' along with French translation 'Carte postale.' The cancellation stamp reads 'Sundsvall.'
